title: Audit log: confirm the sys_user_preference exclusion (#23804) reaches a published platform; HotCRM on 18.0.0-next.2 still logs every ui.recent write
body:
## Source

Read on 2026-10-16 in the console (objectui main `efa9cb4fa`) against HotCRM `4f82b815`, which consumes the published `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.2: Setup › Audit Logs lists 452 records and the first fifty are all `update · sys_user_preference · ui.recent`, one per page the admin opens (the recent-items write). objectstack-ai/objectstack#23804 ("sys_user_preference writes are not audit events") is closed as completed, yet the consumer still floods.

## Target

1. Read what closed #23804 (the PR and its landing) and whether that change is in 18.0.0-next.2 or only on `main`. If it is not published, this card goes `pm:on-hold` with `Restart-when: the fix is in a published @objectstack release that HotCRM pins` and the hold comment says which release.
2. If it is published and the consumer still logs, find why: the exclusion may key on an object name or a plugin path the `ui.recent` write does not take (the preference write from the console goes through `/api/v1/data/sys_user_preference`, not a preference service), and fix the exclusion where the audit plugin reads it, with a test that a `sys_user_preference` update via the data API writes no `sys_audit_log` row.
3. Either way, a one-line note on #23804 saying what was found.

## File surface

`plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts` (the exclusion), the preference write path in `packages/services/service-*` or the console's data API route, tests beside; the HotCRM pin only as a reading.

## Acceptance

1. The reading on #23804; the test per Target 2 if the fix is needed.
2. On a dev instance on the fixed build, opening five records adds no audit rows.
3. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `0f4e3f4ee`, never merged): [r4-audit-logs-preference-flood.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0f4e3f4ee/docs/design/review-r4-2026-10-16/r4-audit-logs-preference-flood.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 fourth review: objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, HotCRM `4f82b815` on platform 18.0.0-next.2, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (dark, en). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed on the repository it belongs to, verbatim: 「全部立卡，平台问题到 objectui，审计日志核查到 objectstack，HotCRM 转化流程到 hotcrm。」</sub>
